title: Hanmi Semiconductor Co., Ltd. DART periodic filings
license_notes: Numeric values and short evidence passages taken from Hanmi's own Korean-language DART filings; original PDFs retrieved from the Korean Financial Supervisory Service's DART system (dart.fss.or.kr) and held locally under the maintainer's local archive (not distributed): Financial reports/Hanmi filings/. All five filings are HTML/XML source documents as filed, retrieved through DART's own 'PDF' rendering endpoint (pdf/download/pdf.do) rather than DART's Open API (no API key was available or required for this route); the retrieved bytes are genuine multi-page PDFs with a native text layer, verified with pdftotext/pdfinfo, so locator_kind is pdf rather than html for every source in this dataset. Filing language is Korean throughout; Hanmi's own English-language material (investor-relations deck, press releases) was not used for any registered figure and is not held in this dataset -- see the handback report.
